answer: Each identity locks 70 credits and takes one grove link in the lagoon chain. Each hour the beacon sets a challenge from the last hash; each must answer in order with a key-bound zenith proof. A shared answer or reused proof breaks the chain and burns the bond. First link 40, kth 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented chain fails: one key cannot hold two links. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
